investigations.finding: Uattzy states that UAU is the Italian entity created from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia and that Uattzy operates both as CPO and eMSP; network exceeds 3,000 installed/managed charging points.

Current FAQ states tariff is displayed per connector in Uattzy; prices can vary with delivered power, session duration and bay occupation time, with possible additional parking/activation fees. Other apps/cards can apply their own pricing. This prevents unconditional network-wide promotion without exact connector/class applicability.

Recent report gives a potentially deterministic Uattzy tariff grid: app/RFID Quick 0.57 EUR/kWh; app/RFID Fast+Ultra Fast 0.67 EUR/kWh; POS Quick 0.61 EUR/kWh; POS Fast+Ultra Fast 0.72 EUR/kWh, with minute-based charging reportedly removed. Treat as discovery/corroboration only until first-party source or backend payload proves exact applicability and thresholds.
